captions.detailed: A teaching-lab benchtop microscope featuring a broad, rounded rectangular base, an angled supporting arm, and a black mechanical stage. Above the stage, a rotating objective turret is mounted to a monocular optical tube with a blue eyepiece lens. The mechanical stage includes a side carriage guide with a dual coaxial control knob extending from the side. The optical assembly slides vertically relative to the frame, the turret rotates continuously, and the side carriage slides horizontally along the stage.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a benchtop teaching microscope with a wide rectangular base, a vertical supporting column, a black mechanical stage, and a monocular optical tube. Incorporate a rotating objective turret, a side carriage on the stage, and coaxial control knobs, ensuring proper prismatic joints for focusing and stage movement.
captions.factory: The code constructs the microscope using several parts and joints. The base, vertical column, and support arms are defined as a single fixed frame using combined box and cylinder primitives. The optical body (including the monocular tube and blue eyepiece) is a separate part connected via a vertical prismatic joint for focusing. An objective turret is attached to the optical body via a continuous rotational joint. The stage is modeled with a horizontal prismatic joint representing the side carriage, while the coaxial adjustment knobs are linked via continuous rotational joints.
